$comment: Startup-immigration bring-up (2026-10-02): curated verbatim passages from the pipeline crawl cache (pipeline/cache/crawl/startup-immigration/<id>/) that the generic extraction pass missed — the startup-law-firms/data-warehouses precedent. Every item's `quote` is a verbatim substring of the cached page mapped from its `url`; pipeline/scripts/append-startup-immigration-docs-evidence.py verifies ALL quotes against the cache before writing (stronger than the law-firms 60-quote sample). Honest absences preserved on purpose: no fee items for vendors that publish no fees (Plymouth Street, Casium, Daryanani, Green and Spiegel, Siskind Susser), no dashboard items for firms without portals, and LegalOS's own 'not a law firm' disclaimer is included verbatim.

alma.quote: Special pricing available for founders of partner VCs and accelerators such as Y Combinator
alma.excerpt: Pricing page footnote: "Special pricing available for founders of partner VCs and accelerators such as Y Combinator"

alma.quote: Approval rates across hundreds of cases. Past success doesn’t guarantee future outcomes.
alma.excerpt: Homepage states the 98%+ approval figure with its basis and an honest disclaimer: "Approval rates across hundreds of cases. Past success doesn’t guarantee future outcomes."

alma.quote: authorized U.S. Agent can serve as the legal petitioner
alma.excerpt: O-1A founders guide covers self-sponsorship mechanics: "For solo founders without an independent board, or founders operating across multiple entities, an authorized U.S. Agent can serve as the legal petitioner. Proper entity structuring from the outset prevents Requests for Evidence (RFEs) challenging ownership control."

alma.quote: no separate billing for RFE responses
alma.excerpt: Published turnaround and RFE terms: "Alma guarantees a 2-week case-preparation turnaround once evidence collection is complete … Pricing is transparent and flat-rate, with no billable hours, no hidden costs, and no separate billing for RFE responses."

alma.quote: Permitting up to three entrepreneurs per startup to receive parole
alma.excerpt: Maintains a dated International Entrepreneur Rule explainer: "Permitting up to three entrepreneurs per startup to receive parole", including the October 16, 2025 $1,000 H.R. 1 parole fee change.
The priced service menu includes dependent filings: "I-539 dependent (per dependent)" as its own flat-fee line item.

lighthouse.quote: Lighthouse does not charge additional fees for preparing responses to Requests for Evidence. Not included: USCIS filing fees, typically around $1-3k and varying by company size, and Premium Processing fees, around $3K.
lighthouse.excerpt: Pricing page separates its fees from government fees and includes RFE work: "Lighthouse does not charge additional fees for preparing responses to Requests for Evidence. Not included: USCIS filing fees, typically around $1-3k and varying by company size, and Premium Processing fees, around $3K."
Homepage publishes operational metrics with a named cohort: Forbes AI 50 badge "1 IN 4 USE LIGHTHOUSE", alongside average-days-to-submission and RFE-rate counters.

lighthouse.quote: Our platform simplifies every step of your case preparation, from uploading documents to tracking what is ready.
lighthouse.excerpt: Case software is part of the product: "Our platform simplifies every step of your case preparation, from uploading documents to tracking what is ready."

lighthouse.quote: Premium processing delivers a 15-business-day decision on EB-1A petitions, but it does not change the standard applied to your evidence.
lighthouse.excerpt: EB-1A guide explains premium processing honestly: "Premium processing delivers a 15-business-day decision on EB-1A petitions, but it does not change the standard applied to your evidence."

lighthouse.quote: The strategic response to both is the same: front-load the petition.
lighthouse.excerpt: Published RFE/NOID strategy: "What an RFE or NOID does to your odds … The strategic response to both is the same: front-load the petition."

lighthouse.quote: H-4 Visa 101: Work Authorization, Benefits & Requirements
lighthouse.excerpt: Publishes dependent-visa guidance: "H-4 Visa 101: Work Authorization, Benefits & Requirements — A practical guide to H-4 eligibility, H-4 EAD rules, and how families can coordinate timing with the principal H-1B holder."

founder-law.excerpt: Pricing page headline: "One flat fee. Everything included." — flat-fee packages for founder work visas and extraordinary-talent green cards with government filing fees included where stated.

founder-law.quote: all-inclusive packages that cover everything, including government filing fees, premium processing, and any RFE responses
founder-law.excerpt: About page: "We offer simple, all-inclusive packages that cover everything, including government filing fees, premium processing, and any RFE responses."

founder-law.quote: Your startup has received at least $264,147\* from qualified U.S. investors or at least $105,659\* in government awards or grants.
founder-law.excerpt: Dedicated International Entrepreneur Parole page with current qualifying thresholds: "Your startup has received at least $264,147* from qualified U.S. investors or at least $105,659* in government awards or grants" (CPI-adjusted per USCIS).

founder-law.quote: Take a look at the list of resources Founder Law packaged for Techstars members.
founder-law.excerpt: Runs an accelerator program: "Take a look at the list of resources Founder Law packaged for Techstars members. You can find clear answers on things like the path to citizenship, International Entrepreneur Parole, Green Card process, and more."

founder-law.quote: A new generation of automated legal tools handles forms at scale. Complex, high-stakes founder cases require an attorney who is accountable for the outcome.
founder-law.excerpt: States its position on legal automation: "A new generation of automated legal tools handles forms at scale. Complex, high-stakes founder cases require an attorney who is accountable for the outcome." (The rebrand page also documents Alcorn Immigration Law → Founder Law.)

deel-immigration.quote: Track your visa progress with live updates and notes from your dedicated case manager.
deel-immigration.excerpt: In-product case visibility: "Eliminate ambiguity with real-time updates: Track your visa progress with live updates and notes from your dedicated case manager."

deel-immigration.quote: Get eligibility confirmation for your employee within 48 hours.
deel-immigration.excerpt: Employer-side assessment SLA: "Get eligibility confirmation for your employee within 48 hours" — free visa assessment with cost breakdown and document requirements.

deel-immigration.quote: more visas in more countries like France, Germany, the Netherlands, and Singapore
deel-immigration.excerpt: Legalpad acquisition announcement on Deel's own blog: "We’ll add their US visa processing services to our existing ones so we can help process more visas in more countries like France, Germany, the Netherlands, and Singapore."

deel-immigration.quote: processed thousands of visas across 50 countries
deel-immigration.excerpt: Scale and destination coverage from Deel's own blog: "we’ve processed thousands of visas across 50 countries—including our most recent openings in India, Argentina, and Uruguay."
Founders track advertises "98% approval rate" with a dedicated case manager; no basis (case count or time window) is published alongside it.

plymouth-street.excerpt: Products page, "plymouth by the numbers": approval rate 98.5% — published as a bare number without a stated case-count basis or time window.
Homepage carries an "In collaboration with" badge section (Y Combinator) and client logos including Replit and Midjourney — "25% of Forbes' Top 50 AI Startups" claimed as customers.
Publishes a dedicated open guide to handling a USCIS Request for Evidence — RFE response work is documented practice, not just marketing.

plymouth-street.quote: References from former employers or clients can provide a comprehensive view of your skills, work ethic, and impact.
plymouth-street.excerpt: Open petition-craft guidance: "References from former employers or clients can provide a comprehensive view of your skills, work ethic, and impact. Highlight specific projects or collaborations that demonstrate your exceptional abilities."

casium.quote: Casium gives your team a dedicated attorney, software built for immigration, and a live view of your entire program. And we have you covered across 90 countries.
casium.excerpt: Organization-side product: "Casium gives your team a dedicated attorney, software built for immigration, and a live view of your entire program. And we have you covered across 90 countries."

casium.quote: shows you every step in one place, all for one clear price
casium.excerpt: Individual-side: "Casium pairs you with leading immigration attorneys, moves your case forward fast, and shows you every step in one place, all for one clear price." (The price itself is not published.)

casium.quote: The modern standard for business immigration: a licensed law firm, technology platform, and service partner in one.
casium.excerpt: Positions itself as "The modern standard for business immigration: a licensed law firm, technology platform, and service partner in one" — visa guides are "Reviewed by licensed immigration attorneys".
A live client portal exists (portal.casium.com sign-in linked from the site header) — the case dashboard is a real product surface.

legalos.quote: Every petition is reviewed by a licensed immigration attorney before filing. Our attorney team is led by Joseph Asir, who has 40+ years of immigration experience.
legalos.excerpt: Named attorney review: "Every petition is reviewed by a licensed immigration attorney before filing. Our attorney team is led by Joseph Asir, who has 40+ years of immigration experience."

legalos.quote: LegalOS Inc. is not a law firm.
legalos.excerpt: Honest structural disclaimer on its own site: "LegalOS Inc. is not a law firm. The information and services presented are not legal advice…" — the attorney-of-record model is review-led, not a law-firm engagement.
States "Fixed-fee pricing, not hourly billing" with fixed per-matter proposals — but publishes no actual prices on the site.

legalos.quote: Pricing for services does not include any government application, biometric or filing fees.
legalos.excerpt: Government fees separated explicitly: "Pricing for services does not include any government application, biometric or filing fees. If you are looking for blank forms, they are available for free at www.uscis.gov."

siskind-susser.quote: Our attorneys literally wrote the original book on the subject
siskind-susser.excerpt: Dedicated startups practice: "Siskind Susser attorneys are experts in finding creative visa solutions for entrepreneurs. Our attorneys literally wrote the original book on the subject: Immigration for Startups: A Guide for Founders."

siskind-susser.quote: Foreign entrepreneurs and investors are often having to adapt visas intended for other purposes in order to use them for self-employment.
siskind-susser.excerpt: Honest framing of founder immigration: "In many ways, US immigration is geared towards US companies employing foreign nationals. Foreign entrepreneurs and investors are often having to adapt visas intended for other purposes in order to use them for self-employment."

siskind-susser.quote: An accompanying spouse and/or any children under the age of 21 may be eligible to apply for an O-3 visa.
siskind-susser.excerpt: Dependent coverage documented on the O-1 practice page: "An accompanying spouse and/or any children under the age of 21 may be eligible to apply for an O-3 visa."

siskind-susser.quote: Visalaw AI is practice-safe AI: SOC 2 Type II certified, no data retention, and built for confidentiality.
siskind-susser.excerpt: Ships its own AI product for immigration teams: "Visalaw AI is practice-safe AI: SOC 2 Type II certified, no data retention, and built for confidentiality" — the only roster firm publishing a stated AI posture as a product.
About page client mix: "Our business clients include hospital systems, large manufacturers, multi-national companies, mid-size family-owned businesses, tech companies, and entrepreneurial start-ups."

siskind-susser.quote: Siskind Susser attorneys are experts on I-9 and E-Verify compliance.
siskind-susser.excerpt: Employer-side compliance practice: "Siskind Susser attorneys are experts on I-9 and E-Verify compliance" — audits, training, and certification offered.

ellis-porter.quote: For applicants who qualify, we refund our attorney fee if your NIW petition is denied.
ellis-porter.excerpt: Published fee structure with a refund guarantee: "A flat attorney fee for the I-140 petition. Adjustment of Status and government filing fees are handled separately. We stand behind our work. For applicants who qualify, we refund our attorney fee if your NIW petition is denied."

ellis-porter.quote: What is your flat fee, what does it include, and is a request-for-evidence response covered?
ellis-porter.excerpt: Publishes the questions founders should ask any firm — including "What is your flat fee, what does it include, and is a request-for-evidence response covered?" — fee-transparency guidance applied to itself.

ellis-porter.quote: Guaranteed approval. No one can promise a USCIS decision.
ellis-porter.excerpt: Lists industry red flags on its own pages, including "Guaranteed approval. No one can promise a USCIS decision." and "Ghost-written or inflated letters."

ellis-porter.quote: NIW premium processing: what it speeds up
ellis-porter.excerpt: Publishes premium-processing guidance: "NIW premium processing: what it speeds up" among its open NIW articles.

daryanani-law.quote: boutique immigration law firm providing first class, attorney-led, personal service tailored to the immigration requirements of foreign nationals and their employers since 1993
daryanani-law.excerpt: "DARYANANI LAW GROUP is a boutique immigration law firm providing first class, attorney-led, personal service tailored to the immigration requirements of foreign nationals and their employers since 1993."

daryanani-law.quote: we can craft a job description that lets you cook but also direct the course of the business. This is allowed on the O-1.
daryanani-law.excerpt: Publishes a worked O-1 entrepreneur scenario — how an entrepreneur can both operate and direct a business on an O-1: "we can craft a job description that lets you cook but also direct the course of the business. This is allowed on the O-1."

daryanani-law.quote: We are a woman-, minority-, and immigrant-owned and led company.
daryanani-law.excerpt: "We are a woman-, minority-, and immigrant-owned and led company." — attorneys supported by experienced paralegals, legal writers, and administrative staff.

green-and-spiegel.quote: we endeavor to understand your business fully and your specific needs as a start-up entrepreneur or small business owner/manager
green-and-spiegel.excerpt: Dedicated small-business/start-ups practice: "we endeavor to understand your business fully and your specific needs as a start-up entrepreneur or small business owner/manager … proactive immigration solutions that are both cost-effective and efficient."

A novel founder pathway of its own design: "The J-1 Incubator Program. Since the program’s launch in 2015, the U.S. Department of State granted multiple university clients the ability to utilize the J-1 Exchange Visitor Program to support increased start-up creation for international researchers at on-campus university incubators."
